text:
alex chen: Quick status — kernel perf sprint: where are we on the KV prefetch change that's blocking canary? timeline for PR review? :eyes:

maria gonzalez: Working through perf regression in kernel loop; I pushed fwk fix in PR #8421 but still seeing 6-8% p99 bump on short sequences.

samir patel: Looking at that PR now. Quick note: the prefetch change adds an extra memcpy on path X; if we change allocation to aligned_alloc it should drop.

jing wu: FYI infra dependency: Dedicated infra team needs the new kernel build artifact name for the rollout script; pinged them earlier — waiting on kevin for naming convention.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan scheduled: canary start 1749902000, abort window 30m. Rollout controlled via rollout_id=r-2024-kernel-prefetch.

alex chen: Ownership: maria for kernel fix, samir for PR review, jing to coordinate infra artifact, kevin to update deploy scripts. Is that correct?

maria gonzalez: correct. Also tagging @kevin o for the artifact name.

kevin o: I'll standardize to "kernelfw-<git_sha>-<date>.tgz" and update the deploy script by EOD. cc @jing wu

samir patel: Reviewed PR #8421 — left two inline comments about buffer lifetime. Fix those and re-run perf bench.

alex chen: Can someone post a quick bench command we should run locally? want reproducible numbers.

maria gonzalez: Use:
```
./bench/runtime_latency --model llama2-13b --seq 128 --batch 1 --iters 200 --prefetch
```
Compare before/after with `perf/bench/compare.sh`.

samir patel: Ran bench on my mac node, p99 went from 88ms -> 94ms with current branch. After changing memcpy to memmove got 90ms. Hope to hit baseline after alignment change.

jing wu: Infra note: canary needs new artifact pushed to s3://redwood-inference/canaries/ — kevin, will you give a thumbs when uploaded?

kevin o: Uploaded v1 today: s3://redwood-inference/canaries/kernelfw-abc123-20240315.tgz :thumbsup:

alex chen: Great. Timeline check — canary start still 1749902000? need to confirm rollback procedure.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1749902010. Monitoring: latency/slo panels watching. Alerts configured: latency_p99 > 140ms or error_rate > 0.5% triggers auto-abort.

maria gonzalez: Noticing slight p50 drift in region us-west-2 but p99 stable so far. I'll collect traces.

samir patel: If the drift persists, we should enable the fallback to quantized variant. PR for fallback logic is #8470 — should be safe.

alex chen: OK plan: if p99 > 140ms or error > 0.5% within 30m, abort and enable fallback. Maria to run trace + heap dump; Samir to prep rollback PR just in case.

maria gonzalez: Acks. uploading a heap dump and flame graphs to the thread: link: https://internal.redwood/si/1749901122/heap

samir patel: I'll stand by for a quick +1 on the rollback PR; hope we don't need it :sweat_smile:

alex chen: Thanks all. Smaller follow-ups: (1) maria — add a one-liner in the PR description about the perf bench command; (2) kevin — confirm deploy script change in the deploy repo; (3) jing — update infra doc with artifact path.

kevin o: Done on deploy repo, PR #92. Jing, I added the artifact naming to infra/docs/deploy.md.

jing wu: Updated infra doc and pinged infra owners. All set.

alex chen: Closing out — will update sprint board with status "canary in flight" and assign tasks. Ping here if anything changes. :rocket:
